'''Ant egg soup''' is a soup made from the eggs of the [[weaver ant]] species ''[[Oecophylla smaragdina]]''. Ant egg soups are traditional dishes in northern [[Lao cuisine|Lao]] and [[Thai cuisine]]. They are also enjoyed on China's [[Hainan Island]]. In addition to soups where they are the central ingredient, [[ant egg]]s may be added as a garnish to a variety of soups. They have a sour flavor.
